{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Clean revenue: remove commas and convert to float
df['revenue_clean'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Filter out QA orders (revenue = 999999.99)
qa_orders = df[df['revenue_clean'] == 999999.99]
df_clean = df[~df['revenue_clean'].isin([999999.99])]

# Filter out refunded orders
df_clean = df_clean[df_clean['status'] == 'completed']

# Compute conversion rates by channel and customer_segment
cross_tab = pd.crosstab(
    index=df_clean['channel'],
    columns=df_clean['customer_segment'],
    values=df_clean['converted'],
    aggfunc='mean'
)

# Compute the difference in conversion rates within each segment
diffs = cross_tab.loc['email'] - cross_tab.loc['paid_search']

# Compute the weighted average treatment effect (ATE)
segment_counts = df_clean['customer_segment'].value_counts(normalize=True)
ate = (diffs * segment_counts).sum()

# Print all required numbers explicitly
print(f'Conversion rate for email, loyal: {cross_tab.loc["email", "loyal"]:.6f}')
print(f'Conversion rate for paid_search, loyal: {cross_tab.loc["paid_search", "loyal"]:.6f}')
print(f'Difference (email - paid_search) for loyal: {diffs["loyal"]:.6f}')

print(f'Conversion rate for email, new: {cross_tab.loc["email", "new"]:.6f}')
print(f'Conversion rate for paid_search, new: {cross_tab.loc["paid_search", "new"]:.6f}')
print(f'Difference (email - paid_search) for new: {diffs["new"]:.6f}')

print(f'Conversion rate for email, returning: {cross_tab.loc["email", "returning"]:.6f}')
print(f'Conversion rate for paid_search, returning: {cross_tab.loc["paid_search", "returning"]:.6f}')
print(f'Difference (email - paid_search) for returning: {diffs["returning"]:.6f}')

print(f'Segment proportions: {segment_counts.to_dict()}')
print(f'Average Treatment Effect (ATE): {ate:.6f}')"}
